decimal: str representing a finite decimal accepted by the existing lexical parser
inputs.binary64: type exactly float, finite operands; decimal lexical tolerances as above

lexical_exactness: Convert sign, coefficient and exponent to a rational without context arithmetic. Constructors may parse notation; every subsequent comparison uses integer ratios. Canonical serialisation preserves numeric value, not spelling, trailing zero count or signed zero.
decimal_rule: abs(a-b) <= max(at,rt*max(abs(a),abs(b))) with exact rational operations

binary_intervals.sets: closed conservative intervals [centre-radius,centre+radius], including zero/subnormal/max-finite cases
binary_intervals.tie_policy: Closed interval over-approximation, not an assertion of exact ties-to-even preimage at binade boundaries.
binary_intervals.classification: within if delta_high<=tol_low; outside if delta_low>tol_high; otherwise indeterminate_boundary
binary_intervals.assurance: Decisive statuses are sound sufficient conditions. The overlapping-interval result can be conservative even if the exact dependency-aware relation has constant truth value.

resource_policy.execution: finite resource budgets may yield RESOURCE_REFUSED, never PASS; refuse before large allocation where necessary
resource_policy.new_material_input_cap: requires explicit further author decision; no cap silently installed in P6

context_invariance: For completed evaluations, changing Decimal.prec, rounding or traps cannot change the exact rational status or numeric serialisation. Context configurations are test parameters.
P7_acceptance: P3 decimal false-admission and strict-interior binary witness are rejected appropriately
M025/M026/M028 contract distinctions exercised by real tests
default and varied Decimal contexts agree
invalid input and resource refusal are separately typed
all existing canonical tests retained, outputs requalified with explicit provenance; no fixed precision patch
